title: 250 pet owners file raps vs crematorium over dumped remains in Bulacan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A total of 250 individuals have filed complaints against a pet crematorium based in Cavite, the Philippine National Police said on Wednesday, following the discovery of dumped pet remains in a vacant lot in Bulacan. “There were already a total of 250 who have come forward to file complaints,” said the PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Rae Co in a press briefing at Camp Crame. READ: PNP urges pet owners to file raps vs crematorium over dumped remains Co said the ashes surrendered to authorities in batches have been sent to the Cavite forensic group for examination.
